target: Add tests/arch/test_claude_command_references.py: a pure-file pytest gate that fails when a slash command references an MCP tool, MCP server, model pin or repo script that does not exist.
invariants: MACRO I01-I10 apply (MACRO_PACKET.json objective + this package).

Check 1: every `mcp__<server>__<tool>` in .claude/commands/**/*.md, where the server has a captured tool list in mcp_tool_surfaces.json (source in {live, seed} and non-empty tools), names a tool in that list.

Check 2: every referenced server exists in mcp_tool_surfaces.json servers, mcp_catalog.yaml, or .mcp.json mcpServers. Referenced servers without a captured tool list must equal an explicit UNVERIFIED_SERVERS constant in the test (currently expected {pal, gpt-researcher}; confirm), so a new unverifiable server fails until deliberately added.
Check 3: every `model:` frontmatter value is in ALLOWED_COMMAND_MODELS = {claude-opus-5-5, claude-sonnet-5-5, claude-haiku-5-5, opus, sonnet, haiku, inherit}.
Check 4: every `scripts/<path>.(py|sh)` mentioned in a command exists in the repo.

Negative control (required evidence): a synthetic-fixture test proves each check fails on known-bad input. The return also records each check's FAIL count when pointed at the base-tree commands (`git archive 95e95bee88cae5e6c95e6e34f7c28bb423ad9496 .claude/commands | tar -x -C <tmp>`), proving the gate would have caught today's defects.
Pure file reads only: no network, no services, no new pytest markers (pytest.ini markers are strict). Runtime < 1 s. Follows tests/.claude/CLAUDE.md naming (test_should_..._when_...).
